summary: Pararius is dutch property portal mainly focused on rental properties, founded in 2006. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Rotterdam rental-home platform (part of TreeHouse) used by over 3 million home seekers a month; has a mid-level software role.

culture.text: Part of TreeHouse, a digital real estate company running Pararius.nl, Huurwoningen.nl and software for estate agents.
Dutch rental property portal founded in 2006, based in Rotterdam.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open mid-level software engineering job in Rotterdam does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Helps over 3 million home seekers a month in the Netherlands and is also active in the UK with RentaRoof.co.uk.

worth_knowing.text: Took legal action against TikTok over fake rental ads.
